text: {"label":"Treating Food Selectivity in Autism","definition":"Behavioral interventions to expand the range and amount of foods accepted by children, adolescents, and adults with autism, including high-probability sequences, modeling, structured meals, and parent training.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses specifically on picky, restricted eating in autistic individuals, unlike broader pediatric feeding disorders work or general autism intervention, reinforcement, and repetitive-behavior topics."}
